title: Making a skincare store easier to shop
heroAlt: Making a Skincare Store Easier to Shop project visual
description: I reviewed an online skincare store the way a shopper would, then built the changes the owner picked.
seoTitle: Making a skincare store easier to shop
seoDescription: A shopper's review of a Shopify skincare store led to a new theme with a skin and hair assessment, clearer product pages, and better search.
teamSize: Solo review for the store owner
constraints: The store sells skincare products, so recommendations about trust and product claims had to stay careful and avoid promising health outcomes.
problem: The owner wanted more visitors to buy, but shoppers had to understand unfamiliar ingredient names to choose a botanical oil.
The skin assessment had no questions, six of the 11 products were sold out, and product pages put the buy button before who the oil was for and how to use it.
A product page scored 90 on desktop and 60 on mobile in Google's speed test.
solution: Followed the shopping path on desktop and mobile, then sent a short report with the fixes in order.
Built a clickable prototype, then worked with the owner to pick the changes that fit his budget.
Built and reviewed the selected changes in an unpublished Shopify theme.
result: The new theme went live on August 7 after checks in Chrome and Safari on desktop and mobile.
Ten days later, the owner said everything was working well.
deliveryHighlights: A skin and hair assessment that recommends oils and skips anything out of stock.
Product filters and summaries by concern, plus clearer product details the owner can edit in Shopify.
Available alternatives on sold-out product pages and search by product name, concern, and assessment terms.
